svg.aria-label: Three stacked line charts, one per condition, each showing a jagged per-step training loss over 1,200 steps with a heavier smoothed line through it, and vertical rules at the three domain changes.
svg.text: The unsmoothed training loss, one panel per condition
every one of the 1,200 per-step losses, unsmoothed (thin line); moving average, span 31 (heavy line); nats
every one of the 1,200 per-step losses, unsmoothed (thin line); moving average, span 31 (heavy line); nats
every one of the 1,200 per-step losses, unsmoothed (thin line); moving average, span 31 (heavy line); nats
training step (single pass over the four domains)
Each update trains on one 256-token window, so a per-step loss is the loss of a single window and varies with the text. The
three panels share identical axes. No point is dropped or subsampled. Source: train_curve.jsonl per condition.
